description: ISO 42001 does not mandate managing keys with a requirement for unique provisioning per purpose, a critical detail for secure AI operations. Add a control for this requirement, ensuring each key is assigned to a specific use case with documented policies and procedures, addressing the gap in ISO 42001:2023’s lack of specific key management requirements. Include guidance on key segregation and purpose-specific provisioning, enhancing ISO 27001 (A.8.24) and ISO 27002 (8.24) for AI-specific cryptographic integrity.
